'''Lahanna Dask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the CEO of [[Belazura Sensor Technologies]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Her son [[Marren Dask]] was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Rift Alliance]]'s military, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]].
